messages:
erin: quick oddity: bundlers (vite/webpack/rollup) are sometimes bundling a CJS shim for a linked workspace package which breaks our edge runtime (no global require). minimal repro below.

erin: repo: apps/site + packages/components, pnpm workspace, components has "type": "module" but exports include an import and a cjs default. app imports `import { Icon } from 'components'`

erin: run: `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm start:edge` -> runtime: `ReferenceError: require is not defined` referencing `.cache/*/vendor-components.js`.

vik: does this happen when components is installed from the registry or only when symlinked?

erin: only when workspace-linked (file: or pnpm symlink). Published package resolves to ESM import fine.

sam: guess: resolver heuristics for linked deps prefer default/main for dedupe and end up using the cjs path. bundlers then inject a CJS wrapper expecting require. edge runtime fails.

erin: tried forcing mainFields/module preference in webpack and vite optimizeDeps but the linked package still resolves to cjs.

sam: short-term hack: remove cjs fallback from exports for workspace packages or publish a snapshot. not ideal.

vik: proposal: change our edge resolve plugin to treat workspace/symlinked packages as ESM-first and map exports.import unconditionally. Add a fast-fail lint that warns on cjs fallback in workspace packages.

erin: I made a tiny repro gist (internal) and started a draft PR sketching the plugin. will add CI matrix for bundlers+link/published.

ci-bot: build: CI job #5120 queued for branch erin/workspace-resolve-edge.

erin: ping for review when the PR is up, thanks!
